Compare initial and optimised Atlantis calibration outputs

compare_outputs.Rd

Reads a saved calibrar results object, builds a side-by-side comparison of the initial and optimised parameter values, and produces a convergence plot showing the per-target fitness over iterations.

Usage

compare_outputs(
  results_file = NULL,
  restart_dir = here::here("inputs"),
  forcing
)

Arguments

results_file

Character. Path to the RDS file written by calibrate (e.g. via its restart option). If NULL, searches for the most recent restart file in the inputs directory. Default: NULL.

restart_dir

Character. Directory where restart files are saved. Used when results_file = NULL. Default: here::here("inputs").

forcing

Data frame of parameter metadata with row names used as parameter identifiers. Must contain at minimum the columns paropt (initial values), parmin, parmax, and parphase.

Value

A named list with two elements:

param_comparison

A tibble with one row per parameter and columns parameter, paropt (initial), paropt_new (optimised), parmin, parmax, and parphase.

plot_changes

A ggplot object showing calibration fitness per target over iterations on a log\(_{10}\) scale.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  out <- compare_outputs(
    forcing = forcing
  )
  print(out$param_comparison)
  print(out$plot_changes)
} # }
